messages:
elaine: Quick sync — want to align on the Snowflake + Databricks connector rollout and coordinated marketplace announcement. Also include vector DB partners and optional hardware perf notes (NVIDIA). Need proposed timeline and owners.

mike: Eng update — PoC connectors working for Snowflake + Databricks on small clusters. Basic end-to-end done but need KV cache tuning and a couple kernel fixes for long seqs. Targeting GA in ~3 weeks if no major regressions. :crossed_fingers:

samir: From SI/integration side — we should confirm mapping for customer schemas and the connector transform hooks. Also want to loop in the systems integrator partner (wev-systems) for validation. Can they get a test account?

jess: Marketing — What’s the proposed embargo/date? We need a co-branded one-pager, press copy, marketplace asset bundle, and a demo video. Suggest soft beta announcement to partners first, then public marketplace listing + blog post. :memo:

kelsey: Legal/security flag — DPA + data residency checklist must be completed before any public announcement. If we're running in Snowflake marketplace but serving on Dedicated/private, confirm data flow diagram and KMS details.

marketplace-bot: Checklist updated: [listing-draft] (internal link), logos requested, legal ack pending, marketplace contact assigned to @elaine.

mike: Proposed short engineering checklist:
```
- finalize kernel fix PR #482
- run perf suite w/ 8k seqs
- add adapter for Snowflake authentication flow
- integration tests: auth, paging, schema mapping
- perf report for marketing (p50/p95 tokens/sec)
```

samir: Vector DB partners — recommend we include Pinecone + Weaviate + Milvus in partner pilot. They can validate embedding footprint and retrieval latencies. Also suggest joint webinar w/ Pinecone engineering.

jess: Webinar + co-marketing sounds good. We should ask each partner for a 1-page blurb and logo by EOD Tue. Proposed embargo: March 26th. Anyone object?

elaine: March 26th works if eng lands the fixes and legal signs off this week. Meeting to lock in assets + timeline — 30m sync. Agenda: owners, marketplace listing contents, SI validation, embargo, hardware perf blurb.

mike: I can be ready for sync. Will push perf report by tomorrow noon.

kelsey: Legal will triage DPA by EOD tomorrow. If any special clauses from Snowflake or SI, flag here.

samir: I'll request test accounts from the SI and Pinecone + Weaviate contacts today.

jess: I'll draft the one-pager template and a slate of headline options. Putting a stub in marketing drive: <https://drive.internal/redwood/partner-assets|partner-assets> :eyes:

elaine: Cool — proposed meeting times: 11:00 or 16:00 PT tomorrow. Reply with preference and I'll send invite + include PRD link. :calendar:
